collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Every dawn one quiet villager carries water to the communal jars, and a young villager notices nobody thanks them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every dawn, one quiet villager carries water from the stream to the communal jars, and (name1), a young villager, realizes nobody has ever thanked them.

choices.label: Leave a Small Gift at the Jars.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The water carrier is surprised and visibly pleased.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The water carrier shrugs it off, but seems to walk a little lighter.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The young villager learns how heavy the work is and gains new respect.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The young villager oversleeps the first morning but shows up the next.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: At the next gathering, the leader thanks the water carrier publicly.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The water carrier dislikes the attention and asks that it not happen again.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The water carrier finds it and smiles.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Someone else takes the gift by mistake, and the young villager tries again.
